newsitem.title: USA: US domestic auto sales off 2.6 pct Jan 1-10 - CNW.
newsitem.headline: US domestic auto sales off 2.6 pct Jan 1-10 - CNW.

text.p: U.S. domestic auto sales fell 2.6 percent in the 10-day period January 1-10 compared with the same period a year ago, according to a CNW Marketing/Research report released Monday.
Domestic car sales dropped to 90,773 from 94,001, CNW said. Domestic truck sales slipped 1.7 percent to 74,038, according to the report.
Import car sales fell 2.6 percent to 22,047, and import truck sales dipped 3.3 percent to 6,855, the report said.
During the first 10 days of 1997, sales in the United States were running at annualized rate of about 13.8 million vehicles, CNW said.
"On a positive note: Sales and floor traffic in areas unaffected by severe weather were about the same in January, 1996," CNW said.
